aboutPreview.headline: Building Reliable Solutions for a Stronger Future
aboutPreview.body: EXPERT TECHNICAL CONTRACTING AND SERVICES is a trusted provider of comprehensive contracting and industrial solutions across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With extensive industry expertise and a commitment to operational excellence, we deliver high-quality services that support the successful execution of projects across multiple sectors.
aboutPreview.body2: Our company is driven by innovation, technical expertise, and a customer-focused approach, enabling us to provide dependable solutions tailored to the evolving needs of our clients. From project planning to final delivery, we are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency.

servicesPreview.subheadline: From coatings and fabrication to civil construction and solar energy — a single source for the lifecycle of your industrial asset.

faq.a1: ETCS is based in the Dana District on Omar Bin Abdul Aziz Street in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (P.O. Box 35514). We take on work with clients across the Kingdom.
faq.a2: ETCS works across four divisions: industrial services (coating and lining, insulation and cladding, refractory, fireproofing, passive fire protection, piping and fabrication, waste management), construction (civil construction, renovation and maintenance, operation and maintenance), engineering (electrical and instrumentation, mechanical works, pre-engineered buildings, solar energy, inspection) and supply (manpower, training, equipment rental, industrial materials).
faq.a3: Yes. ETCS holds ISO 9001:2015 (Quality), ISO 14001:2015 (Environment) and ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety) certification, valid to 21 May 2029, and is registered in the Saudi Aramco Supplier Management System under vendor code 10120303. Certificates are available on request. Pre-qualification with other operators is currently in progress.
faq.q4: Which sectors does ETCS work with?
faq.a4: ETCS supports government, industrial, private and commercial clients — including oil and gas, refining and petrochemical, power, water, storage and terminals, and infrastructure projects.
faq.q5: How do I request a quotation?
faq.a5: Send your scope through the inquiry form on this page, email info@etcs-ksa.com or sales@etcs-ksa.com, call +966 59 051 7642, or message us on WhatsApp. Our team responds within one business day.
faq.a6: Saturday to Thursday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM Arabia Standard Time. We are closed on Fridays. Email and WhatsApp messages sent outside those hours are answered the next business day.
